title: Dry Machine Capability Schema v1
description: Normative schema for machine capabilities and failure-closed lowering boundaries (see docs/26-universal-dry-ir-spec.md Section 2).

axes.description: Number of degree-of-freedom axes supported (3, 4, 5, or 6).

build_volume.description: Bounding box [[x_min, x_max], [y_min, y_max], [z_min, z_max]] in mm.

max_volumetric_flow_mm3_s.description: Maximum extrusion flow rate in mm^3/s.

max_spindle_rpm.description: Maximum spindle RPM for CNC/laser operations.

supported_flavors.description: List of supported controller emission flavors.

supports_power_channel.description: Whether the machine target supports spindle/laser power words (S-word).

supports_toolframe_orientation.description: Whether the machine target supports non-planar 5-axis orientation vectors.
